finding: _pointer does not validate required digest/size values before passing them to _file's optional expected_sha/expected_bytes parameters. Null values skip authentication.
actual_probes: The complete in-memory synthetic acceptance fixture accepted qualification.sha256=null and qualification.bytes=null when both separately rehashed review records referenced qualification_sha256=null.
Real _pointer/_file calls accepted two different file contents and lengths under an unchanged null/null pointer to a synthetic WORK file.
minimal_fix: Validate required pointer SHA with _sha and require an exact nonnegative integer size before read; also validate SHA in the stage pointer branch that omits size.
